purpose: Finances the action plan for the treasury's digital platform, the systems through which the treasury is to act as a bank; the Congolese information-systems agency (ACSI) carries out or manages the work.
scope_basis: A special allocation account created by Loi 39-2023 (Article quinzième, section 3) whose only stated object is the treasury digital platform; held whole.
